agentRules: Node first script under adjacent cursor-agent/versions directories.
Node first script basename codex.js, codex.mjs or codex-cli, or under adjacent @openai/codex directories or a codex-cli directory.
fixturesAdded: Eight busy cases: server under codex/cursor-agent, free-text agent names, Next/relaunching/Playwright paths, later agent-path arguments, non-adjacent cursor-agent/versions and near-match codex package names.

Nine ignored first-script cases: real cursor-agent install with quoted charter, cursor-agent server entry, scoped codex CLI/runtime, codex-cli directory, all three CLI basenames, and node options before the script.
Two grok executable image cases and one reviewer-probe CLI regression.
